message.content: In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑climate weather. The average daily high is about **68 °F (20 °C)**, while the average low dips to roughly **48 °F (9 °C)**. If you’re looking for a single “average” figure, the mean temperature for the month hovers around **59 °F (15 °C)**. This makes December one of the cooler months in LA, but still comfortably warm compared to many northern cities.
